lines.zh: 我走起来有一股土腥味。
lines.en: I walk with an earthy smell about me.

lines.zh: 我是胡萝卜和灵魂沙做的。
lines.en: I'm carrot and soul sand.
My mane is orange.

lines.zh: 我踩过草地，留下橙色的屑。
lines.en: I cross the grass, leaving orange crumbs.
Step by step. Straight ahead.
I walk the ridge and never touch the sprouts.

lines.zh: 我走起来不响，黏土很轻。
lines.en: I move quietly. Clay is light.
I'm sensitive to the smell of grass.
I reach the garden's edge and stop.
I look back the way I came.

lines.zh: 土里的东西，我都闻得出来。
lines.en: I can smell what's in the soil.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子有点脆，走慢点。
lines.en: My hooves are brittle. Slow going.
I often take this stretch.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，有人跟着。
lines.en: Someone follows where I walk.

lines.zh: 鼻子一动一动，闻着草味。
lines.en: My nose twitches at the smell of grass.

lines.zh: 我身上有胡萝卜的味道。
lines.en: I smell of carrots.
I'm waiting for a saddle.
I hear bugs crawling in the soil.
My legs are young and bright orange.

lines.zh: 这一片土很肥，适合种东西。
lines.en: Rich soil here. Good for growing.
I eat nothing. I only smell.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜味的汗，滴在地上。
lines.en: Carrot-scented sweat drips to the ground.
The wind bends my ears.
I'm listening for water underground.

lines.zh: 我这身颜色，是胡萝卜给的。
lines.en: The carrot gave me this colour.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一块晒着的砖。
lines.en: I stand like a brick left in the sun.

lines.zh: 有只兔子在看我，我不动。
lines.en: A rabbit's watching me. I hold still.

lines.zh: 我脚下的草，慢慢长回来。
lines.en: The grass under me grows back.
I shift my weight left.
Dry weather. I like it.
You've got soil on your hands.
I raise my head and look at your face.
Do you grow things?
I lean toward your hands.
You don't smell of carrots.
I lower my head so you can touch my mane.
You're tall. I'd like a run.
I paw the ground lightly.
If you ride, I can carry you.
I tilt my head, mane hanging.

lines.zh: 你停在那儿，我也把蹄收住。
lines.en: You stop there, and I hold my hooves still.
No soil on your hands — very clean.

lines.zh: 我往后退了一步，又上前。
lines.en: I step back, then forward again.

lines.zh: 你身上有刚翻过的土味。
lines.en: You smell of freshly turned soil.

lines.zh: 我掉了几块，站还站得住。
lines.en: A few pieces fall off. I can still stand.
That broke an ear.
I back off and steady myself.
Orange crumbs scatter.

lines.zh: 我不太疼，只是缺了一块。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt. I'm just missing a piece.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子撞掉了一小块。
lines.en: A small chunk breaks off my nose.
Straightening my body slowly.
Stop. I'll fall apart.
I lower my head to guard my forelegs.
That earthy smell has faded.
That orange. I know it.
I lower my head and sniff. Kin.
I won't eat. I only want to smell.

lines.zh: 这个和我身上的味道一样。
lines.en: That smells like me.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜举起来，我靠近。
lines.en: You raise the carrot and I come near.
I stretch my head over and touch it.

lines.zh: 我身上已经有这个味道了。
lines.en: I already smell of this.
Keep it. I don't need to eat.
It's pleasant to smell.

lines.zh: 别拿走，再让我闻一会儿。
lines.en: Don't take it. Let me smell a while.
My legs are clay.
A few orange crumbs fall off.
I angle aside for you to pass.
That bent my ear.
I'm not heavy. A bump makes me sway.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，屑都落了。
lines.en: I shake and the crumbs fall.
Don't push. My four legs aren't steady.
That pushed me to the wall.
You've got soil on you.
I steady myself. Fine.

lines.zh: 两匹橙色的马，站在一起。
lines.en: Two orange horses standing together.

lines.zh: 我们把头靠在一起，很轻。
lines.en: We rest our heads together. Gently.
Its mane is longer than mine.

lines.zh: 土里长出什么，我们都看着。
lines.en: We watch whatever grows from the soil.
Neither speaks. Only wind.
Enough garden here for both.
At dark we stand apart.
The soil will remember this.
It leaves. I stay.
It chose this colour for me.
I pick up a root. Can't chew it.
Not edible. I drop it.
I sniff. Fresh soil.
I push it back into the soil.
Too small. I can't grip it.
I take a root between my teeth.
I shake my leg and it falls.
I'll hold this. Might be useful.
I lower my head, look, and walk off.

lines.zh: 地上这些东西，都是种出来的。
lines.en: Everything here grew from the ground.
Someone's coming. I raise my head.
Saddle me and I'll stand steady.
I guard this garden.
I plant my hooves. No swaying.
Get on, and my four hooves plant firm.
I dislike having my mane pulled.
I lower my head, ears forward.
I know this ground.
Take this path and I'll follow.
I stand at the door and wait.
If you don't mount, I'll wait.
This body can take it.
I keep straight. No change.
Grass sprouts in my hoofprints.
I turn my ears toward you.
Not fast, but I don't get lost.
Smelling the garden, I follow slowly.
I remember this soil.

lines.zh: 我这匹马，是胡萝卜捏出来的。
lines.en: This horse is shaped from carrots.
Wherever you need, I'll carry you.
My hoofprints run all along.
Wind from the east. I know.
A stretch more and we're at the garden.
Before a step, I check.
One pull on the reins and I understand.

lines.zh: 我一蹄踢过去，土都扬了。
lines.en: I kick and the soil flies.
I butt forward. Solid.
That scattered orange crumbs.
I'm no fighter. Only good at running.
Afterward I back two steps.

lines.zh: 我踢出去，橙屑掉了一路。
lines.en: I kick, and orange crumbs trail behind.
You've got soil on you now.
The kick missed and I nearly fell.
I breathe hard. No strength.
Don't come again. I don't want to fight.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，身上还带着根。
lines.en: I rise out of the soil with roots on me.
I shake the dirt off first.
Loose soil here.

lines.zh: 我看了看自己，是橙色的。
lines.en: I look at myself. Orange.

lines.zh: 有人做了我，我应该等他们。
lines.en: Someone made me. I should wait.
I smell a garden.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛是根，还带着甜味。
lines.en: My mane is roots, still sweet.
The wind smells of grass.
I walk forward two steps.
I'm willing to do some work.
Good sun. I don't fear it.
Shredded roots still cling to me.
My shadow is orange.
I rise at the edge of the garden.
I raise my head and look at the sky.

lines.zh: 土下面有灵魂沙，我知道。
lines.en: Soul sand beneath. I know.
Fire scorches the carrot.
I fall from a height and a leg breaks.
Water soaks in and I go soft.
The blast breaks me into pieces.

lines.zh: 东西扎进来，卡在黏土里。
lines.en: Something's stuck in the clay.

lines.zh: 光缠着我，蹄子抬不起来。
lines.en: Light binds me and my hooves won't lift.

lines.zh: 地干了，我身上也开始裂。
lines.en: The ground dried and I'm cracking too.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的形状散了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my shape loosens.
No soil below. I fall.
